numerical_prerequisites.previous_bindings: All twenty earlier source definitions and 10013 request/declaration bindings remain unchanged; explicit ledger extension verifies preservation before writing.

numerical_prerequisites.source_algorithms: Frexp normalizes subnormals; amd64 Log intentionally extracts them directly and includes equality at HSqrt2. Log2 preserves exact powers and compiled inverse Ln2. Public Sqrt uses the compiler primitive. Exp2 retains generic cutoff/reduction/polynomial order; Ldexp retains signed special values, subnormal rounding and machine-int wrapping.

One Exp2 table value differs by one bit. Original alike/close assertions accept these; candidate bits match public Go.
numerical_prerequisites.status: Historical checkpoint; its original counts and differences remain preserved. Six primitives finitely compared on the pinned profile; remaining numerical/functions algorithms, platforms and complete expression/C/accounting gates remain required.
